results:
The search confirms that "seperti air di daun talas" is a variant of the proverb "bagai air di daun talas," which describes someone without firm principles.

- **Meaning:** Several Indonesian sources give the same reading. One describes a person who has no fixed stance and keeps changing ([detik.com](https://www.detik.com/sulsel/berita/d-7784405/130-contoh-peribahasa-dan-artinya-berisi-nasihat-hingga-semboyan-hidup)). Another defines it as someone who lacks a principled position ([Mamikos](https://mamikos.com/info/contoh-kalimat-yang-mengandung-peribahasa-pljr/?halaman=3)).
- **Origin:** The image comes from the leaf's water resistance. Water slides around on taro leaves because a waxy, oil-like layer on the leaf surface stops it from sticking ([Mojok](https://mojok.co/visual/nabati/daun-talas-yang-tiada-mengenal-basah/)).
- **Example usage:** One sentence in a Mamikos example reads: she always sides with whoever holds power, even at the cost of betraying her own siblings ([Mamikos](https://mamikos.com/info/contoh-kalimat-yang-mengandung-peribahasa-pljr/?halaman=3)).

The search results did not turn up a separate formal definition for the "seperti" wording, so the standard form "bagai" is the one to cite.

content.text:
**答案：** 这个比喻用来形容**没有坚定立场、主意老变的人**（印尼语：orang yang tidak punya pendirian / plin-plan，常被称作“墙头草”）。

**依据：**
- 印尼几家网站对这个比喻的通行说法 "bagai air di daun talas" 解释一致：形容立场不定、一直在变的人（[detik.com](https://www.detik.com/sulsel/berita/d-7784405/130-contoh-peribahasa-dan-artinya-berisi-nasihat-hingga-semboyan-hidup)），或没有原则立场的人（[Mamikos](https://mamikos.com/info/contoh-kalimat-yang-mengandung-peribahasa-pljr/?halaman=3)）。
- 这个比喻取自芋头叶：叶面有一层蜡质，水珠留不住，在上面滚来滚去（[Mojok](https://mojok.co/visual/nabati/daun-talas-yang-tiada-mengenal-basah/)）。

我没有找到专门解释 "seperti" 这个写法的来源。上面的来源用的是 "bagai"，两个词都是“像”的意思，所以这个比喻的意思应该一样。

本题共搜索 1 次。
